arguments.command:
python3 -c "
values = [266837, 274362, 277949]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

print(f'Values: {values}')
print(f'Mean: {mean}')

# Calculate population standard deviation
squared_diffs = [(x - mean)**2 for x in values]
print(f'Squared differences: {squared_diffs}')
print(f'Sum of squared diffs: {sum(squared_diffs)}')

variance = sum(squared_diffs) / n
pop_std = variance ** 0.5
print(f'Population variance: {variance}')
print(f'Population standard deviation: {pop_std}')
print(f'Rounded to tenths: {pop_std:.1f}')
"
